RUN WORKSPACE

Dynamic simulation

Select a saved Case to run it.

Save a valid physical line before running: machine → conveyor → machine, with geometry on every conveyor.
At 1×, one virtual second takes one real second. Every conveyor uses named physical geometry: capacity is derived from usable length and product pitch, product travel from conveyor speed, and Prime / Back-up control from its configured sensor positions. Abstract buffers and accumulation-zone overrides are not used.

Scenario controls apply at the displayed virtual second and deterministically recalculate the run. They are simulation controls only; they never command real equipment.

Engine boundary

The browser engine executes the deterministic Case. Apps Script is responsible for identity and Drive persistence; Gemini is not used for calculation. Sensor positions in the public demo are transparent synthetic assumptions, not a PLC or safety-control design.
